- **Degenerate Input:** If a point is far from any brick, it may skip all shells.
- **Time Complexity:** The kernel processes 256 points per group, with shared shell setup reducing overhead.
- **Memory Complexity:** Uses group-shared memory for shells, reducing global memory bandwidth.
- **When to use:** When processing large lists of points for isosurface extraction or interpolation.
